definitions.explanation: the practice of using water efficiently to reduce waste

examples.japanese: {節水|せっすい}に{心|こころ}がける。
{節水|せっすい}{型|がた}のシャワーヘッドに{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: I replaced it with a water-saving shower head.

examples.japanese: {渇水|かっすい}{期|き}には{節水|せっすい}への{協力|きょうりょく}が{呼|よ}びかけられる。
examples.english: During drought periods, cooperation in water conservation is called for.

notes:
{節水|せっすい} means water conservation, an important concept especially during water shortages.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {節|せつ} (economize, moderate)
- {水|すい} (water)

USAGE:
- {節水|せっすい}する (to conserve water - suru verb)
- {節水|せっすい}に{努|つと}める (to make efforts to save water)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {節水|せっすい}{型|がた} (water-saving type)
- {節水|せっすい}{器具|きぐ} (water-saving devices)
- {節水|せっすい}{運動|うんどう} (water conservation campaign)

WHEN USED:
- {渇水|かっすい} (drought) periods
- Summer months when demand is high
- Environmental awareness campaigns

RELATED TERMS:
- {節電|せつでん} (electricity conservation)
- {省|しょう}エネ (energy saving)
- {水道|すいどう}{料金|りょうきん} (water bill)
